changes.SCHED_COVERAGE_151: Coverage phase is driven by remaining high-value unseen questions rather than ending rigidly 10 days before the exam. High-tier first exposure remains eligible until exam-3; valuable MEDIA coverage is targeted until exam-5.
changes.SCHED_HIGH_GOAL_151: MUY_ALTA/ALTA unseen questions are targeted for first-pass completion around exam-9 with up to 120 new questions/day, dynamically recalculated from remaining coverage.
changes.SCHED_DUE_151: Due workload runs in parallel up to 140/day during coverage rescue, without modifying memory stability, target retention, or due_at.
changes.SCHED_ANTISTARVE_151: Due queue interleaves oldest overdue MUY_ALTA/ALTA questions into early positions so partial sessions cannot indefinitely starve old high-value reviews.
changes.MEMORY_PRESERVED_151: Custom memory model and targetRetention remain unchanged; question_memory_state is not reset or migrated.
changes.SCHED_RETENTION_ALIGN_152: Review eligibility now uses due_at OR estimated recall below the current targetRetention, so retention-target increases act as a virtual reschedule without rewriting question_memory_state.
changes.MEMORY_PRESERVED_152: No stability, difficulty, due_at, attempts, or question_memory_state values are rewritten.

supabase_migration.note: No new migration. v1.5.0 migration remains prerequisite only if it was never applied.
